question.prompt: An item marked at 150 yuan is sold at 90% of its marked price and still earns a profit of 35 yuan. Find its cost price (unit: yuan).

solutions.explanation: The selling price is \(150\times0.9=135\) yuan. Let the cost price be \(x\). Then \(135-x=35\). Solving gives \(x=100\).
solutions.title: Find the selling price and solve for cost
